items.title: Top 3 Space Stocks To Watch In October 2026
items.summary: The recent surge in US Treasury yields, with the 10 year rate at levels last seen in the early 2000s, is forcing investors to rethink where they want long term exposure. Expensive borrowing can pressure many sectors, yet it also pushes more attention toward businesses building hard infrastructure for the new space age. This article walks through three stocks from our global space infrastructure list that may warrant a closer look. The three examples in this piece are only a starting sample...

items.title: RTX (RTX) Lands $20.7 Billion AMRAAM Deal Under Arsenal Of Freedom
items.summary: RTX (NYSE:RTX) unit Raytheon has secured a multi year AMRAAM missile production contract worth up to US$20.7b. The agreement supports the Department of War's Arsenal of Freedom initiative to accelerate delivery of advanced air to air missiles. The multi year award is intended to expand AMRAAM manufacturing capacity to meet large scale government demand for missile systems.
